title: P-006 / AUTO-BAR-R-03-P-006 — targeted L4 mutation proof (plan-class-risk-floor)

whyL4IsRequired.mechanism: spec-test-adequacy.ts requiredProofFloor() returns 'l4' when HIGH_RISK_BEHAVIOR_CLASSES includes the clause's behaviorClass; 'lifecycle' is a member. AUTO-BAR-R-10-P-006 is behaviorClass 'happy-path' and carries no such floor.
whyL4IsRequired.note: This row exists because a PASSING journey does not by itself show the journey can FAIL. The mutation below establishes red capability.

mutation.targets: The exact identity the R-03 journey asserts: 'restores the SAME native conversation after the operator OS process exits'. The mutant binds the restored session to a fresh id, so resume restores a DIFFERENT conversation.
preconditionsVerifiedBeforeLaunch: target string occurs EXACTLY once in the file (a multi-site mutation would not be targeted)
mutation sits AFTER the identity guard at lines 39-48, so the guard does not short-circuit it
randomUUID is already imported at line 4, so the mutant still compiles and stays type-correct
su-session-resume.ts is backend-agnostic, so the OMP journey reaches it

probe.tier: in-tree with sweep-lock held (the test reaches the module through the import graph, so copy-out cannot work)

sweepLock.reason: exclude the mutated file from the git-sync sweep for the probe's duration

probe.guardCommandAsOriginallyRecorded: PUI_REAL_BACKEND=omp PUI_REAL_ACCOUNT=auto npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/pui-e2e/agent-chat-pty.integration.test.ts -t 'restores the same native conversation after the operator OS process exits'

guardCommandRepair.defect: EI-22959184107034728 — the command in guardCommandAsOriginallyRecorded CANNOT reproduce the result recorded below. It omits THREE variables the journey requires, so a replay executes ZERO tests. (A fourth, PUI_REAL_MODEL, was correctly absent for this backend — see guardCommandModelPinCaveat.)
omittedAndWhy: PUI_REAL_ENGINE=1 — the target test sits inside describe.skipIf(!scriptedEngine.real) (agent-chat-pty.integration.test.ts:1573), and scriptedEngine.real is process.env.PUI_REAL_ENGINE === '1' (:40). Without it the whole block is skipped and -t matches nothing.
PUI_BIN — ensurePuiBinary() throws 'PUI_REAL_ENGINE requires PUI_BIN from the supported install-update.sh installer' (:268) once real is set.

PUI_NATIVE_ACCOUNT_CATALOG — required whenever PUI_REAL_ACCOUNT=auto, which THIS command sets: 'Native routed-account acceptance requires PUI_NATIVE_ACCOUNT_CATALOG with accounts:list id/provider metadata' (:684).

NOT PUI_REAL_MODEL — this one is a deliberate NON-omission, recorded here because the obvious reading of D-012 gets it wrong. D-012 says to pin PUI_REAL_MODEL on every real-engine leg, but that was derived from the CLAUDE leg (WI-10001027). On THIS journey's OMP backend with PUI_REAL_ACCOUNT=auto the pin is refused at engine start (503 attached_engine_start_failed), so the original command was RIGHT to leave it unset. Ruling: pui-first-party-public-release-2026-09-07#D-013.
guardCommandRepair.whyThisIsAnUnderRecordedCommandAndNotAFa: The run itself was real; only its environment was under-recorded. Two independent corroborations: (1) bindableTestRun.testFileResult reports 'matched=1 ... skippedTests=15', and this file contains exactly 16 tests — 15 skipped + 1 matched means the real-engine block WAS active, which only PUI_REAL_ENGINE=1 produces; (2) the recorded baseline/mutant durations are 105252ms and 188000ms, which no zero-test run can take.

negativeControl.head: ee41f91769
negativeControl.command: the guardCommandAsOriginallyRecorded string above, verbatim, with PUI_REAL_ENGINE / PUI_BIN / PUI_REAL_MODEL / PUI_NATIVE_ACCOUNT_CATALOG explicitly unset
negativeControl.observed: Test Files 1 skipped (1) · Tests 16 skipped (16) · Duration 1.18s · exit 2 · NO TEST_FILE_RESULT line emitted at all
negativeControl.meaning: Zero tests executed. The failure is SILENT in the dangerous direction: a skipped run emits no failing assertion, so a replayer reads it as 'nothing to do' rather than 'this measured nothing' — the same false-green family as a -t matching zero tests.

Three things are settled at once: (1) executed=1 matched=1 vs the negative control's 0-executed silent skip, so the repaired command actually reaches the target test; (2) the 1-passed/15-skipped split independently REPRODUCES the original artifact's recorded 'matched=1 ... skippedTests=15', confirming the original run was under-RECORDED, never fabricated; (3) the ~127s wall time is the same order as the recorded 105252ms baseline and nothing like the negative control's 1.18s.

guardCommandRepair.catalogDurability: The catalog previously used for these runs lived at .papercusp/scratch/p006/account-catalog.json, which .gitignore:187 (**/.papercusp/scratch/) excludes. A committed artifact pointing into gitignored scratch is not reproducible for any successor, so a durable copy now lives in the TRACKABLE tree at docs/evidence/pui-p006-account-catalog.json (verified 2026-09-11T12:33Z: `git check-ignore` says NOT-IGNORED, `git status --porcelain` says untracked-and-sweepable, so the scheduled git-sync sweep commits it — it was NOT yet in a commit at the moment this artifact was written, and a replayer should confirm with `git log -1 -- docs/evidence/pui-p006-account-catalog.json`) and the command below points there.
guardCommandRepair.generalizedFollowUp: EI-22967275079634077 — nothing currently checks that a recorded replay command can reproduce its own recorded result; this artifact carried BOTH failure modes (omitted env, and a gitignored path in a committed artifact).

probe.guardCommandPathNote: PUI_NATIVE_ACCOUNT_CATALOG must be an ABSOLUTE path: the test reads it with readFileSync and vitest's cwd is packages/operator-core, not the repo root, so a repo-relative path silently fails to resolve. Run from the repo root and let $PWD expand.

guardCommandModelPinCaveat.summary: THIS journey runs on the OMP backend, and on OMP the D-012 model pin must be OMITTED. D-012 ('always pin PUI_REAL_MODEL') was derived from the CLAUDE leg (WI-10001027). On OMP with PUI_REAL_ACCOUNT=auto the pin is refused at engine start.
guardCommandModelPinCaveat.measuredRefusal: 503 {"code":"attached_engine_start_failed","error":"--account auto could not be honored: OMP model 'sonnet' is not compatible with gateway account routing; refusing model substitution."}
guardCommandModelPinCaveat.measuredAt: 2026-09-11T12:23Z, HEAD ee41f91769, log .papercusp/scratch/p006/ei22959-positive.log — TEST_FILE_GROUP_RESULT executed=1 status=failed.
guardCommandModelPinCaveat.whyThisIsTheInterestingPart: executed=1 means the test RAN and the ENGINE refused — categorically different from the negative control's 0 executed. It is therefore positive proof that the reproducibility repair works (the command now reaches the test), and separately that a uniform cross-engine model convention is wrong. P-006 is the parity item, so this asymmetry is itself P-006 evidence.
guardCommandModelPinCaveat.correctedFirstAttempt: An earlier revision of this block recorded PUI_REAL_MODEL=sonnet in guardCommand by applying D-012 uniformly. That was WRONG for this backend and is retracted; the pin is removed below.

result.raw: MUTATION_PROBE_RESULT verdict=caught expected=caught target=in-tree:lock-held baseline_exit=0 guard_exit=1 mutant_parse=unchecked
result.meaning: The R-03 journey is FALSIFIABLE: it passes on correct source and fails on a targeted break of the exact property it claims to assert. Exit 0 from the probe means the MUTANT WAS CAUGHT, i.e. the guard failed on the mutant — 'probe succeeded' and 'test passed' mean opposite things here.

restoreProof.method: sha256 of the tracked file compared against the fingerprint bound in the P-006 parity artifact — strictly stronger than an empty `git diff`, which on this swept tree only proves the sweep ran

bindableTestRun.whySeparateRun: admin-test-runs-reporter EXCLUDES source='mutation-probe' rows from test_runs (EI-22955349101740344), so the probe's own baseline is NOT bindable. A separate clean unmutated run was executed afterwards to produce a bindable, tenant-stamped row.
bindableTestRun.exclusionCorroboratedEmpirically: Three runs executed in the window 09:23-09:33Z (probe baseline, probe mutant, clean run) but exactly ONE test_runs row exists (17771169), confirming the exclusion rather than assuming it.

fingerprints.algorithm: sha256-file-set-v1 — sha256 over JSON.stringify of the deduped, lexically sorted [{path, sha256}] entry list (packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/plans/spec-evidence-store.ts fingerprintRepoFileSet)
fingerprints.positiveControl: The algorithm was validated by RECOMPUTING the previously recorded sourceFingerprint (0b82624b…) from the recorded per-file shas before computing the new value, and independently by reproducing the recorded testFingerprint (f2487e4a…) from the current tree. Both reproduced exactly.

supersedes.reason: The P-006 parity artifact's bound sourceFingerprint (0b82624b…) went stale: exactly 1 of its 7 source files drifted — su-session-claude-engine.ts (bound df4a4f3b…, current 47669f7f…) — because the engine fix landed after binding. The other 6 files are byte-identical.
supersedes.repairable: Yes. Bindings are append-only, so a NEW binding carrying the recomputed fingerprint supersedes the stale rows rather than requiring a new spec revision.
